interface: Claude Code subagents (Agent tool), 16 fresh subagents x 4 items per manifest.json batches
independence: Each subagent was instructed to read only its 4 item files (and judge.mjs for shape validation) and received no arm, score, or review information. All 16 reported reading nothing else. The orchestrating session built the items and had seen the paper and prior review outcomes, but did not judge any item. Batches 11, 12 and 13 listed the verdicts directory while creating it and so saw other opaque verdict filenames, without opening them.
notes: All 64 verdicts passed scoreDecisions validation on the first attempt.
